subject: swedish
summary: Swedish questions are legible, the letters å, ä and ö render correctly, and the attached reading text is the correct passage with no other questions on its first page. The schemes are uneven. One comprehension answer is cut off mid-sentence, ending in a comma, and another ends with a stray line reference ('r 43-55'). The two essay cards behave differently: one shows no criteria and a 0-40 number grid, the other shows three criteria as tick boxes without marks. A verse quotation in an essay title has lost its line breaks. Several schemes are single long paragraphs with one tick box.

issues.title: Scheme answer cut off mid-sentence
issues.detail: The only scheme point ends '... medan skelettet fortfarande är formbart , helst före elva års ålder,' - it stops on a comma, with a stray space before another comma. The grey note says the scheme takes possible answers from paragraphs 7, 14 and 15, so more than one point is expected, but only this one truncated block is shown, with a single 5m tick.
issues.suggested_fix: Restore the full scheme text and split it into its separate possible answers, one per line.

issues.title: Essay cards inconsistent; one has no marking content
issues.detail: Card 3 shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', eight lines of grey explanation on the phone, and a 0-40 button grid under the heading 'Select the points you actually got'. Card 5, the same kind of essay, shows three criteria as tick boxes with no marks. Neither tells the student how 40 marks are earned, and the two look like different products.
issues.suggested_fix: Use one essay layout: the criteria as a plain 'what the examiner looks for' list, then the three self-grade buttons. Remove the 0-40 grid.

issues.title: Verse quotation flattened; essay instruction run into title
issues.detail: The Shakespeare quotation is printed as running prose with capital letters mid-sentence where the line breaks were: 'Den man, som ej inom sig har musik, Och icke rörs av sköna toners endräkt Är böjd för svek, bedrägeri och rov Tro ingen sådan man!'. On both essay cards the instruction 'write about one of the two topics below' runs straight into the one topic shown, and card 5's title has no closing punctuation.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the verse line breaks; put the instruction on its own line above the title.

issues.title: Stray line reference at end of scheme point
issues.detail: The last scheme point ends '... som hoppas att de når dit. r 43-55'. The 'r 43-55' is the examiner's line reference (rad 43-55) and reads as a typo.
issues.suggested_fix: Show it as '(rad 43-55)' in grey, or remove it.

issues.title: Single-paragraph scheme with one tick; long grey notes
issues.detail: Card 1's 30-mark scheme is one 18-line paragraph on the phone with a single tick box, mixing suggested content with instructions to the examiner ('Arbiturenten måste utgå från ...'). Every card's first scheme box carries a four-to-seven line grey note about the answer-in-Swedish rule. Card 1's attachment button is labelled 'READ DEL II' although the page it opens is the main reading passage.
issues.suggested_fix: Split card 1's scheme into 'Suggested content' and 'The examiner requires' with one line per sentence; state the language rule once outside the boxes; label the button 'Read the passage'.

good_examples.why: Three separate scheme points that plainly explain the quotation; correct passage attached
Clear question and a relevant sample answer, readable on desktop
